name: 5-TFMO-DMT
summary: 5-TFMO-DMT (5-(trifluoromethoxy)-DMT, 5-OCF3-DMT, 5-(trifluoromethoxy)-N,N-dimethyltryptamine) is a psychedelic tryptamine derivative related to drugs such as 5-MeO-DMT and DMT (DMT).2 nM. It was shown to release serotonin (5-HT) from synaptosomal preparations, and to reduce immobility time in the forced-swim test in animal studies, suggesting that it might have antidepressant activity.

pharmacology.text: It acts as an agonist at the 5-HT2A receptor with an EC50 of 127.2 nM.

uses.en: It is a research compound studied for possible antidepressant activity.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於研究可能的抗憂鬱活性。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于研究可能的抗忧郁活性。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psychedelic tryptamines, can cause nausea, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的迷幻色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的迷幻色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: Its trifluoromethoxy group packs three fluorine atoms onto a single carbon. In animal tests it reduced the time mice spent immobile, a standard sign of antidepressant-like activity.
fact.zh: 它的三氟甲氧基在一個碳上接了三個氟原子。在動物測試中，它減少了小鼠不動的時間，而這是類抗憂鬱活性的標準指標。
fact.zhHans: 它的三氟甲氧基在一个碳上接了三个氟原子。在动物测试中，它减少了小鼠不动的时间，而这是类抗忧郁活性的标准指针。
